title: Exotic Sri Lanka for Couples: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Bentota
alt: A couple on the golden sand at Bentota beach at sunset
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel with views over the Kandy valley

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

activities.name: Full day Kandy city tour
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Peradeniya botanical gardens, the Bahiravokanda Buddha and the gem museum.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights above Kandy lake with the elephants of Pinnawala on the way in, a dance show and a full day of the city and its gardens.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel on the slopes above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night in Nuwara Eliya with a private full day of its waterfalls, gardens and lake.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class boutique stay a short walk from Bentota beach

activities.name: Edinburgh viewpoint and Kitulgala
activities.description: A stop above the tea terraces on the way down from the hills, then the rainforest river town of Kitulgala.

activities.name: Madu River boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga, then the turtle hatchery at Kosgoda and the Bentota beaches.

activities.name: Excursion to Galle and Mirissa
activities.description: South along the coast to the Dutch fort at Galle with its ramparts and lighthouse, then on to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Three nights by the sea: a scenic transfer via the Edinburgh viewpoint and Kitulgala, a river safari and turtle hatchery day, and an excursion to Galle and Mirissa.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with a full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens and the orchid house
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and the gem museum
Dinner at the hotel overlooking the valley
3: Breakfast and a private transfer up to Nuwara Eliya
Ramboda Falls and a tea factory tasting on the way
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the Hakgala gardens
Check in and dinner in Little England
4: Breakfast, then the Edinburgh viewpoint above the estates
A pause at Kitulgala on the Kelani river
A transfer on to Bentota and check in by the beach
The evening at leisure on the sand
5: Breakfast, then a boat safari through the Madu Ganga mangroves
The cinnamon island and the fish spa at the river mouth
The Kosgoda turtle hatchery in the afternoon
Optional: a candlelit dinner on the beach
6: Breakfast and an excursion along the southern coast
The Dutch fort at Galle: ramparts, lighthouse and old church
Mirissa beach and sunset from Coconut Tree Hill
7: Breakfast and a transfer up the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Eight days built for two: Kandy and its dance show, a night in the tea country, three nights at Bentota with a river safari, turtle hatchery and the Galle coast, and a final night in Colombo.
included: Included: 7 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; Kandy lake drive and dance show; a full day Kandy city tour; private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; the Edinburgh viewpoint and Kitulgala stop; a full day Bentota sightseeing with the Madu River boat; a day excursion to Galle and Mirissa; full day Colombo sightseeing. Dance show and Bentota activity tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
